fib.py - Provides iterative and memoized-recursive Fibonacci functions returning the n-th Fibonacci number.
fizzbuzz.py - Prints Fizz, Buzz, or FizzBuzz for numbers 1 through 30 based on divisibility by 3 and 5.
matrix.py - Implements transpose and multiply helpers plus shape validation for rectangular matrices represented as lists of lists.
primes.py - Provides is_prime and first_n_primes functions for primality testing and generating prime lists.
stack.py - Defines a Stack class implementing a LIFO stack with push, pop, peek, is_empty, and size methods.
test_fib.py - Unit tests verifying the iterative and recursive Fibonacci implementations, including large and negative inputs.
test_matrix.py - Unit tests for matrix transpose and multiply, covering square, non-square, and shape-mismatch cases.
test_primes.py - Unit tests for is_prime and first_n_primes, including small primes, composites, and large values.
test_stack.py - Unit tests for the Stack class covering push, pop, peek, size, and empty-stack error behavior.
